_comment: Parameter database for Sony SCENE files. status: confirmed = proven by file diff and/or manual+page; likely = strong indication; hypothesis = guess, verify on camera. Sources: community articles and the FS7 / FS7 II manuals (menu option lists, value ranges, 'saved in files' table).

00006.name: Preset Matrix
00006.evidence: Index = order of the manual's Preset Select list. Verified: sample look (FL Light) = 2, sample look (Cinema) = 3. BT.2020 only with 4K/QFHD rec format. FS7 Mk1 manual lists only 5 presets (Standard..F55 709 Like): BT.2020 exists only on FS7M2. sample set A Mk1: F55 709 Like = 4 confirmed on FS7 Mk1. sample set C FS7II sample look/sample look: first field 0 with preset 4 stored -> 0 = Preset Matrix Off (consistent with 1 = On) FS7M2 round 10 (2026-10-09): Preset Matrix Off + Preset Select F55 709 Like changes only this value '1,0' -> '0,4' (first field On/Off, second field the preset); with Off the preset select is not selectable on the camera.

00007.name: User Matrix
00007.evidence: Neutral R-G +10 -> 3293, R-B +8 -> 2635; sample look Level +23 -> 7574, Phase -5 -> -1647. Raw = menu step * ~329.3 (manual range -99..+99). Unit = 32768/99.5 = 329.327; camera values deviate by at most 1 raw unit from step*unit. sample set A Mk1 files: Level +15 -> 4940, -20 -> -6586 (phase and the rest 0). sample set C FS7II files: R-G +99 is stored as 32767 (not 99*329.33=32603) -> raw is capped at +-32767 (negative end assumed symmetric) FS7M2 round 9 (2026-10-09): Level -8 -> +8, Phase +5, R-G -5, R-B +10, G-R -10, G-B -3, B-R +3, B-G -7 give '1,2635,1647,-1647,3293,-3293,-988,988,-2305' (field order Level, Phase, R-G, R-B, G-R, G-B, B-R, B-G, scale 329.33 per step), Preset Cinema (3) -> Standard (0).

00074.name: Multi Matrix (hue and saturation per axis)
00074.evidence: Manual: 16 axes x (Hue, Saturation) = 32 values. Non-zero only in sample look files. Probable order: 16 hue values, then 16 saturation values (sample look: sat raised on R/R+/YL- = orange) - unverified FS7M2 round 8 (2026-10-09): Hue +10 on axis B- changes position 15 to 3293, Saturation -10 changes position 31 to -3293: positions 0-15 = hue per axis, 16-31 = saturation per axis (axis order of the menu: B, B+, MG-, MG, MG+, R, R+, YL-, YL, YL+, G-, G, G+, CY, CY+, B-). Area Indication and the selected axis are not stored.

widget.note: 32 values: the first 16 are the hue per axis, the last 16 the saturation per axis (order as in the camera menu: B, B+, MG–, MG, MG+, R, R+, YL–, YL, YL+, G–, G, G+, CY, CY+, B–). Area Indication and the selected axis are not stored in the file. ● marks axes with a value.

00085.name: Gamma Select: HG (index HG1-HG8)
00085.evidence: Only ID differing between HG3/HG4 and HG7/HG8 file pairs; 2..5 match the manual's HG list order. Category (STD/HG/User/S-Log2/S-Log3) is a separate, still unidentified ID. sample set A sample look (STD5 R709) = 4, sample look (HG8) = 5, Universal (S-Log3) = 4: index is within the category, so S-Log3 = 4 is not an HG/STD index -> category matters

widget.note: Applies while the gamma category is HG (assignment HG1-HG4, HG7, HG8 = 0-5).

00158.name: Preset White (K) per ND slot (?)
00158.evidence: First value = Preset White in K: sample look 4900 (page), sample set C FS7II files all 5600 (daylight preset), sample set B 6000/2800/4900/5700. Mk2 has 6 values = probably Preset White per ND-filter slot (CLEAR/1/2/3 + variable CLEAR/On), only the first is changed in all sample files. Older FS7 files only one value

00144.name: White memory A: R gain, B gain (?)
00144.evidence: Same two values are the first two entries of 00164 in all files (FS7M2: sample set B -7604,750 / sample set C 9227,-21402; FS7: sample set A 8338,-19829). Memory A of Paint > White

00164.name: White memory A: R gain, B gain, colour temp K (?)
00164.evidence: Third value = colour temperature of the stored white (sample set C 5624, sample set B 2872); first two = 00144. 00165 = memory B (sample set B 5625; sample set C unused 0,0,3200). 00166..00181 (0,0,3200) are probably further white memories (per ND slot)

00057.name: Knee Point
00057.evidence: FS7M2 round 11 (gamma category S-Log3 -> STD, Knee Setting Off -> On, Auto Knee On -> Off, Point 90 -> 80, Slope 0 -> +5): 90000 -> 80000 (= 80.0 %, file value x 1000). Manual: 75 to 109 %, default 90 %. The button steps (1 %) are an assumption.

widget.note: Manual: Knee Point 75 to 109 %, default 90 %. The file holds the value times 1000.

00084.name: Auto Exposure A.SHT Limit
00084.evidence: FS7M2 round 48 (2026-10-13): Auto Exposure A.SHT Limit 1/2000 -> 1/250 changes exactly this ID (scene 00084 / ALL 00225): 2000 -> 250 (the value is the denominator). It was 2000 in every earlier file, so the old reading 'ISO / EI value (FS7 base sensitivity)' was wrong. The manual lists 1/100, 1/150, 1/200, 1/250 and 1/2000; other values may exist.

widget.note: The value is the denominator of the shortest exposure time of the automatic shutter (manual: 1/100, 1/150, 1/200, 1/250, 1/2000; 1/250 is confirmed by a file).

00008.name: Master Black
00008.evidence: FS7M2 rounds 17-23 (2026-10-13), clicked one wheel click at a time: every stored value is a whole multiple of 41.351 (one wheel click; 8 clicks = 330.8, about one menu step). The camera shows the click count divided by 8, cut towards zero: 0 for -7..+7 clicks (-289..+289), -1 from -8 (-331) to -15 (-620), -2 from -16 (-662), -3 from -24 (-992), -4 up to -39 (-1613), -5 from -40 (-1654 .. -1778 at -43); +1 starts at +8 (+331). Measured: -827 (-20), -662 (-16), -620 (-15), -331 (-8), -289 (-7), +289 (+7), +331 (+8), -992, -1613, -1778. The Mk1 values (-1075, -1158, -1654) are multiples of the same unit (26, 28, 40 clicks) but do not fit the 8-click menu raster of the Mk2: the Mk1 menu step width is not measured. The range of 99 menu steps = 792 clicks is an assumption (32767 / 41.351 = 792.4).

_transfer._comment: Rules for switching the target camera model. Default: an ID is copied between models if it exists in both with the same number of fields and the value is valid for the target. none = model specific (never copied, values differ systematically between FS7 and FS7M2 or unit unknown); first = only the first field is copied. 2026-10-09: 00002 (Multi Matrix Setting), 00037 (Aperture Setting), 00068/00069 (White Clip) are carried now: their meaning is the same on both cameras.

00008._comment: Master Black: raw wheel value of the same displayed step (-2, -3, -5). Mk1: sample set B/A files; Mk2: FS7M2 013.ALL (-2), 010.ALL (-3), 014.ALL (-5), taken in the middle of the step; -4 on the Mk2 = -1613 (012.ALL). The wheel has finer values than the display, so a step is a range, not one value.

00036.name: Aperture Level
00036.evidence: the author of sample set A FS7 Mk1 files: Aperture Level +30/+20/+9 -> 9880/6586/2964 (= steps * 329.33). FS7 Mk1; FS7M2 files all 0

00037.name: Aperture Setting (On/Off)
00037.evidence: FS7 Mk1: 1 in the three sample set A files (APERTURE ON), 0 in sample set B's files (Aperture OFF). FS7M2: 1 in all sample set B files although the page says Aperture OFF - meaning on FS7M2 unclear, hence model specific. sample set C FS7II: 1 in sample look, 0 in the four others -> the flag does vary per look on FS7M2 as well (aperture meaning plausible) FS7M2 round 5 (2026-10-09): Aperture Off changes only 00037 1 -> 0 (Level 9 -> 12 = 2964 -> 3952 in 00036). Equals ALL 00069 (id_map).

widget.note: With Off, the Aperture level is greyed out.

00069.name: White Clip Level (90.0 to 109.0 %, file value x 10)
00069.evidence: 1080 in all sample set A files and FS7M2, 1055 in sample set B's FS7 files; manual: White Clip Level 90.0-109.0 %, default 108.0/105.0 % Manual: 90.0-109.0 %. Values seen: 1055 (sample set B FS7), 1080 (sample set B FS7M2), 1090, 1080 (sample set A).

widget.note: Manual: White Clip level 90.0 % to 109.0 %; the setting (On/Off) returns to On when the camera is switched off, permanently off = level 109 %; not adjustable with gamma category S-Log2/S-Log3 (the camera switches it off there). Rule of thumb: standard gamma 105 %, HyperGamma (HG3/HG4/HG7/HG8) 109 %, otherwise the camera clips the highlights hard; live/broadcast 100 %.

00017.name: Gamma Category (STD / HG / User / S-Log2 / S-Log3)
00017.evidence: STD flag: 1 only in sample set A sample look (STD5 R709). 00143 = 1 only in sample set A sample look (S-Log3), 00019 = 1 in the HG files. Same block as the ALL file (id_map: 00017 -> 00039, 00019 -> 00041, 00022 -> 00044, 00078 -> 00190, 00143 -> 00494). FS7M2 rounds 25-30 (2026-10-13): leaving STD switches Knee Setting and Black Gamma Setting off by themselves (HG, S-Log3: both 0); back in STD the camera restores the state STD had (round 27: both On again, because they were On before; round 30: both stay Off, because they were Off before the detour).

widget.label: Category
widget.note: The gamma category consists of five flags (00017 STD, 00019 HG, 00078 User, 00022 S-Log2, 00143 S-Log3; exactly one is 1). Gamma Select has its own IDs per category (00018 STD, 00085 HG); S-Log2/S-Log3 have no sub-selection. The user selection is not yet assigned in the SCENE file.

00060.name: Knee Setting (On/Off)
00060.evidence: FS7M2 round 11 (gamma category S-Log3 -> STD, Knee Setting Off -> On, Auto Knee On -> Off, Point 90 -> 80, Slope 0 -> +5): only this ID changes 0 -> 1 for Knee Setting On. (An earlier reading as one of three STD flags was wrong: STD is the category flag, the third one the White Clip setting.)

widget.note: With Off, the other knee settings are greyed out (assumed like gamma, black and white clip; the camera display in the Off state was not checked). The manual says Knee is active with gamma category STD only.

widget.note: With Off, the White Clip level is greyed out. With S-Log2/S-Log3 the camera switches the setting off.

00097.evidence: FS7M2 round 43 (2026-10-13): Camera > ND Filter > Preset 1 1/4 -> 1/8: field 0 of ALL 00280 (scene 00097, id_map) 4 -> 8, the other fields unchanged (the camera also stood on a different gamma category in this file). Round 44 (2026-10-13): Preset 2 1/16 -> 1/32 and Preset 3 1/64 -> 1/128 change fields 1 and 2 (16 -> 32, 64 -> 128) and nothing else, so the three fields are Preset 1, 2 and 3; fields 3 to 5 (4608 / 4096, 0, 4) are unknown. The FS7 Mk1 has no variable ND presets (0, 0, 0, 4096 there): the dropdowns are shown for the six-field shape of the FS7M2 only. Round 48: Auto Exposure > Auto ND Filter Off -> On changes field 4 (0 -> 1): the automatic ND filter is stored in this ID (likely).

widget.note: The value is the denominator of the ND fraction (1/4 to 1/128); all three presets are confirmed by files.

00160.name: Shutter
00160.evidence: FS7M2 round 52 (2026-10-14): Camera > Shutter > Mode Speed -> Angle and Shutter Angle 180 -> 216 degrees changed scene 00160 / ALL 00459 field 0 (0 -> 1) and field 1 (9 -> 10) and nothing else. Field 1 is the position in the manual's angle list (5.6, 11.2, 22.5, 45, 90, 120, 144, 150, 172.8, 180, 216, 300: 180 = 9, 216 = 10). Mode 0 = Speed, 1 = Angle; Off = 3 is an assumption from the manual's order.  Round 53 (2026-10-14): Mode Speed/Angle -> ECS and ECS Frequency 50.xx -> 49.77 Hz changed field 0 (1 -> 2, ECS = 2 confirmed) and field 3 (563 -> 559) and nothing else; field 3 is therefore the ECS Frequency (hypothesis for the coding: about 11.23 per Hz, 559 / 49.77 = 11.23, which would make 563 about 50.1 Hz; the exact earlier frequency is not known). Not editable yet. Fields 2, 4, 5, 6 (4, 0, 0, 7) unknown. Round 54 (2026-10-14, 25P format): Mode ECS -> Speed, Shutter Speed 1/50 -> 1/25 and ECS Frequency 49.77 -> 55.02 Hz changed fields 0 (2 -> 0), 2 (4 -> 3), 3 (559 -> 613) and 6 (7 -> 6) and nothing else. Field 2 is the position in the manual's Shutter Speed list of the frame rate (25P: 1/3, 1/6, 1/12, 1/25, 1/50, ...: 1/50 = 4, 1/25 = 3), likely; the list differs per frame rate, so it is not editable yet. Field 3 (ECS Frequency): 559 = 49.77 Hz and 613 = 55.02 Hz fit roughly v = 10.29 x f + 47 (hypothesis, only two points with rounded values; 563 would be about 50.2 Hz). Field 6 (7 -> 6) moved together with the speed, meaning unknown. Fields 4 and 5 (0, 0) unknown. Round 56 (2026-10-14, ALL only, 25P): ECS Frequency 34.00 Hz (after switching Mode Speed -> ECS: field 0 0 -> 2) gives field 3 = 297. With 49.77 -> 559 and 55.02 -> 613 the coding is v = floor(1125 - 28125 / f) for 25P (1125 = total lines of an HD frame, 28125 = 1125 x 25): 34.00 -> 297.8, 49.77 -> 559.9, 55.02 -> 613.8 (all match the truncated value); the earlier 563 is 50.04 Hz. Inverse f = 28125 / (1125 - v). Presumably 1125 x frame rate for other frame rates (not checked). Likely, three points. Round 57: Mode Off = 3 confirmed (field 0 -> 3).

widget.note: Only the Shutter Angle is active in Angle mode. Scene files do not contain the recording format, so the Shutter Speed list and the ECS Frequency are only editable in All files.
